name: concept_wolf

desc: A muscular slime wolf monster made of glossy pale lavender-grey goo, three-quarter view facing left, standing idle, wolf head with a large white spiky mane flowing back from the head, red eyes, open grin with the tongue out and goo dripping from the mouth, one arm raised flexing, lower body melting into a pale grey goo puddle, drips running down.
